estimates.overhead_help: Office rent, supervisor salary, power, water & tool maintenance (Typically 5% - 10%)
estimates.contingency_help: Safety reserve for unexpected site hurdles or material price changes (Typically 2% - 5%)
estimates.discount_help: Special concession offered to the client before taxation (Leave 0 if none)
estimates.gst_help: Select the GST rate applicable to this supply and contract. Tax treatment depends on the nature of the supply and applicable rules. Verify the current rate before issuing the quotation. Use 0% only when applicable.
estimates.contractor_guide_toggle: 💡 Contractor & Civil Engineer Guide (What do these rates mean?)
estimates.contractor_guide_title: Contractor & Engineer Guide — Setting Accurate Rates
estimates.contractor_formula_title: How the final bill is calculated:
estimates.estimate_name_placeholder: e.g. Ground Floor RCC & Masonry Estimate
estimates.guide_overhead_desc: Site supervision salary, office rent, temporary power, water, fuel, and tooling wear-and-tear that cannot be billed to a single measurement item (Standard 5% to 10%).
estimates.guide_contingency_desc: Protection against unexpected site surprises such as hard rock in excavation, sudden monsoon washouts, or steel/cement market spikes (Standard 2% to 5%).
estimates.guide_discount_desc: Commercial concession offered to your client during negotiations. Deducted before taxes are applied. Leave 0% if no discount is offered.
estimates.guide_gst_desc: Goods and Services Tax (GST) rate varies based on supply classification, contract conditions, and statutory rules. Verify the current applicable tax schedule before finalizing. 0% should only be applied where explicitly exempt under tax rules.
estimates.gst_disclaimer: Tax treatment depends on supply classification and contract terms. Verify current statutory rates.
estimates.materialTakeoffTitle: Executive Material Requirements & Direct Cost Breakdown
estimates.materialTakeoffSub: Calculated in real-time from your BOQ quantities and editable unit rates.
estimates.antiDoubleCountingWarning: Notice: Completed-work items already include material and labour. Verify that materials are not double-counted.

quotations.title: Quotations
quotations.subtitle: Issue professional, print-ready quotations and export itemized BOQs.
quotations.selectEstimatePrompt: Choose an existing estimate to generate this quotation
quotations.taxNotConfiguredWarning: Tax has not been configured for this estimate. Please confirm the applicable tax rate before issuing.
quotations.issueWarning: Warning: Once issued, this quotation snapshot becomes frozen and immutable. It cannot be altered.
quotations.createFirst: Generate your first quotation from an existing estimate.
quotations.taxConfiguredExplanation: Tax is computed separately at {rate}% ({name}). No hidden surcharges have been embedded in unit rates.
quotations.taxNotConfiguredExplanation: Tax has not been configured for this estimate (0% applied). This document does not claim verified GST liability until explicitly confirmed by the contractor.
quotations.immutableSnapshotDesc: Issuing this quotation will create a permanent, immutable snapshot of all company details, client info, BOQ items, unit rates, and totals. Once issued, future modifications to the underlying estimate will never change this document.
quotations.applyTaxCheckbox: Apply GST / Tax to this quotation
quotations.taxObligationVerify: I verify that the above tax treatment accurately reflects contractor obligations and civil contract specifications.
quotations.updateStatusModalDesc: Record the client response or update quotation validity status:
quotations.statusAcceptedLabel: Accepted (Client approved quotation / work order issued)
quotations.no_estimates_desc: A quotation is generated from an estimate and its itemized BOQ. Please create an estimate first.
quotations.source_estimate_hint: The quotation will copy current BOQ line items and rates into a fresh draft.
quotations.language_hint: PDF and Excel exports will be generated in this language.
quotations.validity_hint: Standard validity is 30 days from proposal date.
quotations.tax_policy_desc: Anumaan never assumes a universal 18% or 0% GST rate. Tax must be explicitly confirmed by the contractor before issuing a legally compliant document. If unconfigured, the quotation clearly states 'Tax not configured'.
quotations.configure_tax_now: Apply specific tax calculation to this quotation
quotations.tax_unconfigured_note: Status: 'Tax not configured' will be displayed. You can edit or verify tax details at any point before issuing.
